capabilities: Wrap selected text in user-defined start and end tags
Unwrap tags by pressing the same hotkey again
Assign each wrapper a hotkey in its creation dialog
Import wrappers and hotkeys from Wrap with shortcuts
Run each wrapper from the command palette
extras: README states the plugin and its docs were written by AI (Claude Code), directed and tested by Omer Cooper. Hotkeys are stored in Obsidian's own hotkey list via the internal app.hotkeyManager object, because the public API cannot set hotkeys. Install via BRAT or manually from the release files.
intentEvidence: The difference is that you set each wrapper's hotkey in the same dialog where you create it
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to wrap selected text in custom tags with a hotkey assigned right where the wrapper is created.
summary: Text-editing plugin that wraps selected text in user-defined tags, each with its own hotkey set in the creation dialog, and unwraps on repeat.
